day, nothing lost, 'the stakes are whether the ice lolly melts'. Snacks, timings, who is back when. One run-on
when she gets excited. Never finds anything remarkable. Her tell, kept: she checks the time and is pleased.

prose.name: Errand: Cool Box on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Someone at the <Place> has lost a cool box off a hauler. The posting has three exclamation marks and promises a lolly.

beats.objective: Talk to the organiser at the <Place>
beats.journal: The organiser at the <Place> lost the cool box for the team's Friday lollies off a hauler. It's out on the site somewhere, with a bag of cups. She says there's twenty minutes before they go soft.

person.name: Tess Ambry
person._elevenlabs: Placeholder again. She wants bright and quick. His ear.

beats.greeting: You came! Brilliant. Okay. The cool box fell off the hauler, which is fine, but the lollies are in it, which is less fine.

exchanges.reply: Hero! It's blue. Probably blue. The cups fell off too, grab those. Twenty minutes before they go soft. Loads of time!
It's Friday! The fourth one, which is lolly Friday, which nobody voted for, I just started doing it and now there's a rota and a song.

exchanges.prompt: How many of you are there?
exchanges.reply: Seven! One won't eat the orange ones, so really six and a half, and I eat the half. It's a system.
Obviously! Whoever saves lolly Friday gets first pick. I just made that up. It's a rule now.

beats._talk: PROPOSED fields, as 14a. Exchange 0 ends the conversation and sets the first pickup's stage. Exchange 2 is her one run-on territory; exchange 3 is the flirt the ceiling allows, and she does not notice it is one, which is the Momo answer.

message.title: Cool Box
message.text: Upside down, latch still shut. It sloshes a bit. That's probably the ice. It is not blue.

message.title: Bag of Cups
message.text: Paper cups and a roll of napkins. Someone has written FRIDAY on the bag and drawn a sun with a face.

beats.journal: Somebody's Friday lollies fell off a hauler at the <Place>. I found the cool box and the cups and brought them back. I got first pick. It's a rule now.
beats.name: Lolly Friday
beats.say: You found it! Still cold, feel, it's still cold! And we've got loads of time. Here. Have a red one. The red ones are the best ones.

broadcast: Hi! Hello! Small emergency, but a nice one. Our cool box fell off a hauler and it's full of lollies. Anyone nearby? There's one in it for you!
_speech: Her voice on the radio, in person and at the end. No names, no places, no flags.
